'''Sparis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Sparis sold a wide variety of items from a shop in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] market.

==Behind the scenes==
Sparis was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears in Anchorhead, the Republic-only city on Tatooine, as a Social Items Vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
